answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the pearl log exposes the live set and the tide audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 132 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 168 aliases alive as a result means 168 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the onyx quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
